# Repository context

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [the constitution](../.specify/memory/constitution.md), and [current context](../docs/project-state.md). Read only the relevant feature contract/source owner next.

No unit/mock/JSDOM/content suites or synthetic previews. Only authorized real Foundry module checks; otherwise report NOT RUN. Build only for release packaging. Preserve GM control and performance-sensitive hook/resource rules.

Use project-local Spec Kit overrides rather than stock test-first instructions. Do not infer new services, hooks, or test tooling from upstream examples.
